__NOTOC__
== Ingredients ==

=== Hazelnut chocolate dipping sauce ===

* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Hazelnut|hazelnut]]-flavored [[Cookbook:Syrup|syrup]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Chocolate Syrup|chocolate syrup]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] pure [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla extract]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Cream|whipping cream]], [[Cookbook:Whipping|whipped]] to soft peaks

=== Masa bites ===
* ½ cup whole [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolks]]
* 20 corn [[Cookbook:Tortilla|tortillas]], torn into small pieces
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* ¼ cup unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Quart|quarts]] [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]], for frying

== Procedure ==

=== Hazelnut chocolate dipping sauce ===

# Combine syrups and vanilla.
# Gently [[Cookbook:Folding|fold]] in whipped cream.
# Refrigerate until needed.

=== Masa bites ===
#Place milk, eggs, salt, and sugar with the tortillas in a [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]], and pulse until chunky paste is achieved.
#Move to a mixing bowl and stir in the butter. Work fast to prevent melting.
#Pour oil into a 6-quart [[Cookbook:Dutch Oven|Dutch oven]] and heat to 375°F.
#Roll tortilla mixture into 1 to 1½-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] balls. [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|Fry]], 6–8 at a time, until crisp and golden brown, about 2–3 minutes.
#Drain on a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|cooling rack]] set above a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|sheet pan]] and let cool 1–2 minutes.
#Serve warm with the hazelnut chocolate dipping sauce.
